requirements.statement: A user must sign in before using the app, and their todos are kept private to them

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor cannot view or manage any todos
A signed-in user only sees their own todos, never another user's
A user's todos are still present after signing out and signing back in

requirements.statement: A user can add a todo

criteria.must: Adding a todo with a title creates it and shows it in the user's list

requirements.statement: A user can view their list of todos, seeing what's pending and what's done

criteria.must: The todo list distinguishes pending todos from done todos

requirements.statement: A user can mark a todo as done

criteria.must: Marking a pending todo as done changes its status to done

requirements.statement: A user can unmark a todo they previously marked done

criteria.must: Unmarking a done todo changes its status back to pending

requirements.statement: Todos are persisted in a database so they survive across sessions and devices

criteria.must: A todo created in one session is still present after reloading the app in a new session
